title: Commander narrative summary

paragraphs.text: The narrative repeats the return, SEATO demonstration, Golf aggressor exercise, and Princeton PHIBLEX. It adds post-return transfers, limited training, and understrength companies.

notes: Narrative says mid-November PHIBLEX; detailed entry gives November 19. Approximately 50% battalion strength in the narrative differs in scope from approximately 40% participating company manning in the PHIBLEX entry. Keep these distinct.
